verdict.rationale: Termius's own site states it connects directly to servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN, and stores infrastructure locally. Its docs list native SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial and SFTP client support. Missing for 10: in-depth technical documentation of the connection path (only a marketing-page claim), independent or hands-on corroboration that sessions never route through Termius infrastructure.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can connect directly to my servers without relying on a cloud relay, proxy, or VPN

citations.quote: Connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN.
Termius doesn't depend on the cloud to manage your access. Your infrastructure is stored and encrypted locally.
It includes a built-in Local terminal and supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP.
